name: AXM Game Hub
description: Local lobby and launcher where human players and adapter/AI seats can connect, switch seats, and launch swappable game modules from a shared game library.

seat_selection.default_rule: first eligible ready players fill selected game capacity
seat_selection.overflow_rule: extra lobby players become skip, spectator, or next-round queue

responsibilities: pass selected seat map into game session
rule: Game Hub is a standalone local module. It is the lobby and launcher, not one game. AI/adapters must occupy visible seats. Lobby stability matters more than perfect per-game lobby reshaping.
